description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the TrueType bytecode interpreter, including constants, function types, call records, and the main execution context structure used in font rendering.

methods.name: TT_RunIns
methods.description: Executes one or more instructions in the given execution context, main function of the TrueType opcode interpreter.

methods.name: TT_New_Context
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new execution context for a given font face.
